I was in Amway for awhile. It's not a pyramid in the sense that it's a scam. You could make some money off of it.

However the best time has long past. The return has not kept up with the inflation of the products. In the 70's you could sell say $100,000 worth of soap and get a check for $20,000 or whatever. Now you need to sell a million dollars worth of stuff to get that same $20,000 check.

However depending on who is sponsoring you it could be good for business connections. The group I was in would say once you hit "direct" level they get you in of other business deals (a lot of real estate stuff). So the goal was within 5 years of being "direct" only 10% of your income would be coming from Amway. "Directs" were making $30-40k/yr at the time. So enough to get you out of your job and free you up to pursue other investments.
